text:
elaine: Quick pulse before CI runs: what are the absolute must-pass gates for the Optimize pilot? need a minimal checklist for SRE to validate.

sam: Minimal gates: 1) golden prompt suite available + baseline metrics; 2) perf SLIs (p50/p95/p99) for pilot pool; 3) cache stability test (12h no OOM + hit_ratio >= 70%); 4) quant opt-out flag per tenant; 5) eval alerts wired to pager.

priya: Alert thresholds proposal: page if golden_mean_f1 drops >4% over 30m OR any new failure class >5% of total. No auto-rollback in MVP — humans triage first.

cheng: I'll own dashboards + instrumentation. Events: opt.batch.latency.p95, opt.cache.hit_ratio, opt.eval.golden_f1. Will push a small dashboard and a smoke harness by EOD.

sam: Canary ramp: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with min observation windows 6h/12h/24h. Stop if error_rate > 0.8% OR p99 > 2x baseline OR golden regression alert fires.

eng-oncall-bot: ci-bot: preview deploy queued (optimize/pilot-readiness). jobs: cache-stress, perf-smoke, golden-eval.

elaine: Great, thanks. Action items: sam to publish short gate doc, cheng to land dashboards, priya to drop golden set, eng-bot to run e2e. reconvene 9:30 tomorrow if smoke passes. :thumbsup:
